sloka: अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम् ।राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०६.१ ॥
transliteration: avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṁ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam ।rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṁ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt ।। 7.106.1 ॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama with his face downcast and distressed, like the moon submerged in sorrow, Lakshmana, with a firm resolve, spoke gentle words to him.
